data.text: א  Aleph Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with all my heart, ב  Beth In the council of the upright and in the congregation.
ג  Gimel Great are the works of Yahweh; ד  Daleth They are sought by all who delight in them.
ה  He Splendid and majestic is His work, ו  Vav And His righteousness stands forever.
ז  Zayin He has made His wondrous deeds to be remembered; ח  Heth Yahweh is gracious and compassionate.
ט  Teth He has given food to those who fear Him; י  Yodh He will remember His covenant forever.
כ  Kaph He has declared to His people the power of His works, ל  Lamedh In giving them an inheritance of the nations.
מ  Mem The works of His hands are truth and justice; נ  Nun All His precepts are faithful.
ס  Samekh They are upheld forever and ever; ע  Ayin They are done in truth and uprightness.
פ  Pe He has sent redemption to His people; צ  Tsadhe He has commanded His covenant forever; ק  Qoph Holy and fearsome is His name.
ר  Resh The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom; שׂ  Sin Good insight belongs to all those who do His commandments ; ת  Tav His praise stands forever.
